ns2:course.label: Advanced Scenographic Drafting
ns2:course.description: Advanced drafting techniques for scenic design, lighting design, and technical production. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: THEA 225 or permission of the instructor. Restricted to Theatre majors only.
